limitations: Controlled candidates are known-clean references with injected bias, not model inference.
Real examples are 256px repository visualizations; candidates use built-in imagegen and are resized back to 256px.
DESOBA manually deshadowed panels provide a shadow-region reference, not object-removal ground truth.
Outside-predicted-envelope exactness is by construction; false-positive edits are separately measured on annotation-defined background.
Five controlled backgrounds are independent textures but foreground cutouts reuse the five real examples.
No SVOR image generation, training, paid external GPU or parameter sweep.
